profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer In Test at Cboe Global Markets

positions.title: Software Engineer In Test
positions.description: Writing and updating tests and testing framework code in Python to support the CBOE system of exchanges.

positions.title: Senior Test Analyst
positions.description:
Test analyst in the Orders and PowerPlans group.
Specializing in Oncology PowerPlans and Java Services.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a contract basis. Designed mounting solutions for milking parlor backend that contributed to ~50% cost reduction over previous solution. Was part of two person team that designed milking parlor cabinet and raceway that also contributed to meeting the cost target.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Broadcast system analysis and design.
On site project management. 
CAD drafting and design of signal flow and system architecture.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Compiled and maintained a database of prospective clients.
Located prospective clients through online research using Google Earth and Hoovers Database.
Created a geocoded map of prospective clients using Google Earth and Salesforce.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Received samples of toys in different stages of development and checked them for safety and functionality.
Found engineering solutions to various problems as needed.
Worked with cross-functional team to ensure standards were met.

positions.title: Civil Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Performed Engineering Cost Estimates for West Thames St. Park.
Drafted roadwork in AutoCAD.
Revised and updated existing CAD drawings.

honors.title: With Honor
honors.issuer: Issued by Stevens Institute of Technology · May 2012
